title: Preselection of hypo TT in carb UI
symptom: When entering carbs while low, the carb UI preselects 'start hypo TT', which can cancel an existing activity TT with a higher and longer duration. This can lead to the target resetting to default and the loop giving too much insulin, causing a severe hypo.
cause: The carb UI preselects 'start hypo TT' even when a higher and longer TT is already set, causing the hypo TT to override the activity TT.
fix: The issue was fixed by a patch (PR #4339) that changes the logic so that hypo TT is not automatically selected when there is already a high TT > 100 mg/dl or 5.5 mmol/L with a duration longer than the preset hypo TT duration.
evidence_quote: When low, I think Hypo TT should automatically be selected when entering carbs, unless: There is already a high TT > 100 mg/dl or 5,5 mmol/L with a duration longer than preset Hypo TT duration.
